3. उपरोक्त पद पर तवर्थ नियुक्ति श्री राव को पद्धति विश्ले 
पक के पद पर नियमिन नियुक्ति के लिए कोई हक प्रदान नहीं 
करेगी । तवर्थ तौर पर उनकी सेवाएं उस ग्रेड में वरिष्ठता और 

आगे उच्च पद पर पदोन्नति के लिए नहीं गिनी जाएंगी । उपरोक्त 
पद पर सवर्थ नियुक्ति को नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी के विवेक पर किसी 
भी समय बिना कोई कारण बताए रद्द किया जा सकता है । 

सं० 11/ 116 /79-प्रशा० - - 1585 - - राष्ट्रपति , उत्तर

दिसम्बर , 1979 के पूर्वाह्न से अगले आदेशों तक जनगणना कार्य 
निदेशालय उत्तर प्रदेश , लखनऊ में प्रतिनियुक्ति पर स्थानान्तरण

प्रमाणित/ प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि भेजनी चाहिए जहां से वह मैट्रिकुलेशन

वास्तविक आयु निनी होनी चाहिए ।

की अभिप्रमाणित प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि न भेजी जाए तो उम्मीदवार को उसे 
म भेजने का कारण अवश्य बताना चाहिए और अपेक्षित योग्यता में संबद्ध 
अपने दावे के समर्थन में किसी अन्य प्रमाणपत्र की प्रतिलिपि भेजनी चाहिए 
आयोग इस माक्ष्य पर उसकी गुणवता के आधार पर विचार करेगा । किन्तु

की अभिप्रमाणित प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि में परीक्षा के विषय नहीं दिए गए

प्रयोजन से पाम तौर पर रहता है ।

8. उम्मीदवारों को चेतावनी दी जाती है कि वे आवेदन-पत्र भरते 
गमय कोई भठा ब्यौरा न ८ अथवा किमी महत्वपूर्ण मूचना को न 
छिपाए । 


(v ) नियम 5 ( ख ) ( ix ) अथवा 5 ( ख ) (x ) के अन्तर्गत प्राथु 
सीमा में छूट चाहने वाले ऐसे उम्मीववार को , जो रक्षा सेवा में कार्य 
करते हुए विकलोग हुपा है , महानिदेशक , पुनःस्थापन , रक्षा मंत्रालय , मे 
निम्नलिमित निर्धारित फार्म पर इम प्राशय का एक प्रमाण-पत्र लेकर 
उसकी एक अभिप्रमाणित प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि प्रस्तुत करनी चाहिए कि वह 
रक्षा सेवा में कार्य करते हुए विदेशी पान देश के साथ संघर्ष में अथवा प्रशाति 
ग्रस्त क्षेत्र में फौमी कार्यवाही के दौरान विकलांग हमा और परिणाम 
म्वरूप निर्मुक्त हुमा । 


उम्मीदवारों को यह भी चेतावनी दी जाती है कि वे अपने द्वाग 
प्रस्तुत किए गए किमी प्रलेख अथवा उसकी प्रति की किसी प्रविष्टि 
को किसी भी स्थिति में न तो ठीक करें न उसमें परिवर्तन करें 
पौर न कोई फेरबदल करें और न ही कोई फेरबदल किए गए/ मूठे 
प्रलेख प्रस्तुत करें । यदि ऐसे दो या इससे अधिक प्रलेखों या उनकी 
प्रतियों में कोई अशुखि अथवा विसंगति है तो विसंगति के सम्बन्ध 
स्पष्टीकरण प्रस्तुत किया जाएगा ।

9. भावेदन -पत्र देर में प्रस्तुत किए जाने पर देरी के कारण के रूप 
में यह सके स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा कि भाषेवन-पत्र ही अमुक सारीष 
को भेजा गया था । प्रावेदन -पत्र का भेजा जाना ही स्वत : इस बात का 
सूचक न होगा कि भाषेदन -पत्र पाने वाला परीक्षा में बैठने का पात्र 
हो गया है ।

New Delhi-110003, the 25th January 1980 
No. 1 / 2 /79 -FFD . The National liim Festival of india is 
organised by the Lirectorate of Film Festivals , Ministry of

The Festival aims at : 
(i) Encouraging the production of films of acsthetic 

excellence and social relevance , 
( ii) contributing 10 the understanding and appreciation of 

the film cultures of different regions, 
( iii ) promoting the feeling of integration and unity of the 

nation .

culty lec of ks. 100 in case of uilms exceeding 1 ,000 me.ers in

Ite may be made by Demand Diaft, payable at the Siate Bank

Director , Directorate of Film festivals and sent along with

9 . Two Juries will be constituted by the Government of 
India one for judging feature films and the other jor judging 
short films. 

10 . The composition of the Jury for Feature films will be 
as follows : 

(a ) A chairman nominated by the Government; and 
(b ) not more than 24 members distinguished in the field 

of arts and humanities, including hilms, and qualified 
to judge thematic , artistic and technical merits of 
nims. The menibers will be nominaied by the 

Government. 
11 . Panels may be constituted by the Chairman (at his 
discretion ( ii considered necessary ) out of the members of the 
Jury tor Feature Films to examine feature films in various 
languages and the children s films. 

12 . Each panel will recommend to the aforesaid Jury for 
Feature Fims, not more than three films in cach language con 
sidcred suitable for awards, without indicating order of merit. 
Il , liowever , in the opinion of the panel , à particular film 
txcels over other filins examined by it meriting considera .ion

13. The Jury for Feature Films will thereafter view all the

of awards under rule 24 - 1 of these regulations. 

1. 4 The Jury for Feature Films will first select the award 
Winners for the following three categories : 

Best Feature l ilm under rule 24 - 1 ( i) . 
Best Feature film with mass appeal, wholesome entertain 
nient and aesthetic value under rule 24 -1 ( ü ) . 
Best Feature Film on National Integration under rule 
24 - I ( iii) . 
The films selected for these awards will not be eligible 
for regional awards under rule 24 - 1 ( iv ) of these Regula 

tions . 
15 . The Jury for Short Films will consist of a Chairman 
and not more than four other members. The fury will be 
constituted by the Government. The Jury will recommend 
films for categories of awards under rule 24 - 11. 

16 . Any person directly or indirectly associated with any 
film entered in the National Film Festival will not be eligible 
to serve on the Jury for Feature Films and the Jury for Short 
Films as the case may be . 

17 . Both the Juries may determine their own procedure for 
the examination of films. 

18. The quorum of the two Juries shall not be less than 
half the number of members nominated . 

19 . The Director , Directorate of Film Festivals or his 
nominee may attend the deliberations of both the Juries with 
the objective of providing necessary information and clarifica 
tion regarding the scheme of National Film Festival, 

20 . The members of both Juries shall treat the deliberations 
as confidential. Also while working as members of the Jury , 


2 . Any film produced in India and received by the Central 
Board of Film Censors for certification in 1979 and certined 
not later inan 31sc of January , 1980 and consistent with the 
objectives of the festival can be entered in the festival. in case 
of Film Institutes recognised by the Govcillorant any film 
produced during 1979 can be entered . This will not, however , 
exempt such films from the provision of certirication by the

should be in 35 mm or 16 mm gauge . The lengil or short 
fiims should ordinarily not exceed 1000 meters in case of 35 
mm or 400 meters in case of 16 mm . 


3 . A censored film entered in the festival should , subject to 
Regulation 2 , be exactly the same as certified by the Board of 
Film Censors . 


4 . No film with which a member of the staff of the Direc 
torate of Film Festivals is associated can be entered in the 
National Film Festival. 


5 . An entry can be made either by a Government Depart 
ment, a Government recognised Institute or by individual pro 
ducer / production company. Enclosed entry form ( in dupii 
cate ) duly completed must reach the Directorate of Film 
Festivals not later than 15th March , 1980 . 


6 . Prints of films entered for the National Film Festival 
chould reach the Directorate of Film Festivals latest by 15th 
March , 1980 . If possible the prints may be sen : along with 
the entry forins. Immediately after despatching the print, the 
sender should notify the Directorate of Film Festivals by mail / 
telegram the title , the language of the film , the number of reel: 
and the date and mode of despatch of the print.

Warning to Roud Users 

No. 78 /RE / 161 / 1 . - - It is notificd for information of gene 
tal public that in connection with introduction of 25 KV AC 
Electric traction , Height gauges have been orccted at all the 
level crossings in the section Gudur ( Excl.) to Bitragunta 
( incl.) of South Central Railway with a clear height of 
15!-4 " ( 4 .67m ) above road level with a view to prevent 
louds of excessive heights from coming into contact with or 
in dangerous proximity to live traction wires. Public are 
hereby notified to observe the height specified above for the 
purpose of loading vehicles and to act that the loads carrieci 
in road vehicles do not infringe the height gauges under any 
circumstances . 
The dangers of a load of excessive height are as follows : 
( i) Danger to the height gauge and consequent obstruc 

tion to the road as well as the Railway line. 
( ii) Danger to the materials or cquipment carried on the 

vehicle itself . 
( iii ) Danger of fire and risk of life due to the contact 

with or dangerous proximity to the live conductors. 
The Railway administration will not be liable for any 
accident caused due to this warning heing ignored . 

K . BALACHANDRAN , Secy . Rly . Buarci
